TimersCalendar={ OnCalendar=*-*-* 00:00:00 ; next_elapse=Mon 2026-08-31 00:00:00 -03 }
NextElapseUSecRealtime=Mon 2026-08-31 00:14:26 -03
LastTriggerUSec=Sun 2026-08-30 00:09:19 -03
AccuracyUSec=1min
RandomizedDelayUSec=1h
Persistent=yes
Id=logrotate.timer
Description=Daily rotation of log files
LoadState=loaded
ActiveState=active
SubState=waiting
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/system/logrotate.timer
UnitFileState=enabled
